song: 20 - Cuenta Bien - Edwin Bonilla - Jesús “El Niño” Pérez.
title: the board deals the cha-cha, then the timbal fills and the drop burn the solo
story: At 117 bpm the timbal descarga plays one deal per beat over a terracotta palette, with the colour turning per bar and the board half-bar flips. The fills 4919-5079 are the anomaly: five timbal hits each a deal burst, a zoom push and a posterize stab, escalating to the 22.5 hit out of the near-silence at 5005-5056. The drop at 5103 explodes the board (paso 6, separation 0.3, an 8-fold mandala for one beat). The post-roll burns like a solo: eighth-note deals, sliding pieces, the palette turning every 2 beats, every timbal peak a hard shake, and each four-bar phrase in a different state.
